status: APPLICATION for the maintainer's decision; NOT authorized, nothing launched, no storage created
what: H1-PA's student phase: PA2v, one short L40S GPU validation; then PA2, the four trainings (D4-Original and D4-Augmented, two seeds each) and the six nucleus_v1 evaluations of eval-set-1 (those four checkpoints and PCA-Original's two, never retrained), in one cumulative envelope with the study's network volume

frozen._harness: over h1pa_governance.harness_files() on the tree this application was written from; issue() recomputes it on the session commit and the pod's setup re-checks it, so a later code change shows up as a different digest, never a silent one

scope.recipe: E1's config per seed: batch size 2, micro-batch size 1, 3 epochs, AdamW lr 5e-5, CE 0.25 + KD 1.0; D4-Original 2,916 optimizer steps, D4-Augmented 3,702 (E1's rule on its 2,468 sequences); nothing else changes
scope.evaluation: eval-set-1 every item, nucleus_v1 bound explicitly and refused when absent; the preregistered rule decides A and B, C is descriptive
not_requested: any retry of a complete valid measurement

hardware.why: measured on this exact configuration: E1 trained it on L40S at a 39.96 GB logged peak (sa train_log.jsonl) and 1.78 s per sequence pass (cost_forecast.json, n=21); full eval-set-1 evaluations ran on L40S (n=21). PA2v re-measures both under H1-PA's own inputs and nucleus_v1 before anything formal; no GPU type is assumed unsuitable without a measurement
hardware.datacenter: chosen at launch from a live query among those with L40S stock and network-volume support (2026-10-24: EU-NL-1, EUR-IS-2, US-MO-1, US-NC-1, US-TX-3, each Low); the volume is created there and locks every session to it; one GPU type for every formal unit
hardware.image: runpod/pytorch:1.1.0-cu1300-torch291-ubuntu2404 (CUDA 13: host driver >= 580); the host driver of every session is recorded

training.runs: X1 and X2 uninterrupted, Y killed with SIGKILL right after its step-12 save point on the network volume and resumed with --resume latest; plus 12 steps of D4-Original on E1's pack

checks._memory: 48 GB card, at least 4 GB headroom; E1 logged 39.96 GB for this configuration
checks.training: every run completes its steps; loss and gradient norm finite
checks.config: the run's recovery_config.json differs from the seed's E1 config only by WHERE, tokenizer_source and the validation-only overrides; D4-Original's and D4-Augmented's formal recipes derive with no key outside their declared overrides
checks.initialization: D4 Top-1 restored and re-identified from its bytes
checks.pca_checkpoint: model.safetensors' sha256 is the recorded one
checks.resume: P1g's rule: data order and learning rate identical at every resumed step; loss and final weights within twice the run-to-run difference of the two uninterrupted runs (or 1e-6)
checks.persistence: Y's final model persisted to the volume and re-identified from the landed bytes; the probe file written, fsynced and read back with its sha256
checks.capacity: the provider's size is the planned 30 GB; the measured save point is no larger than storage.bytes.save_point x 1.02
checks.decoding: every generation summary carries nucleus_v1's sha256 and its sampling; every sample's seed is the protocol's request_seed for its item and turn; every sample records output token ids and a stop_reason in {eos, degeneration, context_limit}
checks.repricing: the formal sessions are priced from PA2v's measured median step seconds; issuing a formal authorization needs the repriced hard cap to fit the live envelope

gpu_validation_PA2v.gate: ENFORCED in code: h1pa_governance.issue refuses a formal authorization without a passed PA2v gate (pa2v_gate), which is RE-DERIVED at issue time from PA2v's secured evidence -- its validation authorization under this grant, a COMPLETE closeout with the pod gone, the evidence archive's hash, every check run again -- and must name the same study identity and harness as the formal session; the formal launch re-checks the gate its authorization names (the_pa2v_gate_holds)

storage.verified_by: the launcher refuses a volume whose PROVIDER-reported size is not the plan's; the driver counts free space as that size less the bytes on the mount before every persist and every training, after a write/read-back probe; PA2v measures the real save point and its gate refuses one larger than planned
storage.period: created immediately before PA2v in the chosen datacenter; kept through PA2 and until the preregistered analysis and the maintainer's independent review are complete (h1pa.json :: retention); its storage record books the reservation, so it never bills unmanaged; at closeout the retention need, migration route and cost are reported and the lifecycle decision is taken

money._cap: the maintainer's cumulative phase limit, kept at $50: it covers what the phase is expected to cost, NOT every session reaching its hard cap at once
money._worst: PA2v + both seed sessions at their all-in hard bounds + the storage reservation; not funded and not requested: the cap is not raised to it
money._need: PA2v and the first seed session at their conservative expected cost + the second session's all-in hard bound + the storage reservation. Every session's hard cap still covers its own real workload; when the envelope left at issue time cannot cover the next session's hard bound, its authorization is refused and nothing is created
money.repricing: PA2v's measured median step time prices both seed sessions' training (+10 min per training for loading, E1's in-run validation and the save points); the first seed session's measured full evaluations price the second's (x1.25), in place of the conservative forecast. Never fewer steps, a smaller evaluation, a dropped seed or a changed rule
money.cap_scope: CUMULATIVE over PA2v and PA2: every attempt's GPU, container disk and termination margin, and the study's storage; a rerun never receives a fresh allocation

project._: provider billing counted once (pods + network volumes, all time); the PA1 pod has posted

residual_risks: floor: under greedy decoding E1's PCA 2.96M student answered 1.75% of the static fluid items, below the 2% floor; A or B may end NOT_RESOLVED (FLOOR), which the rule reports as no evidence either way
two seeds per arm; GPU training is not bitwise deterministic, so seed variation is reported per seed and is outside the interval

E1's config saves one mid-run save point (save_every = T // 2) and is not changed: a pod lost late in a training resumes from the half-way point; the replacement subrun must fit the envelope or the phase stops and reports
L40S stock is Low in every datacenter with network volumes; a create waits at $0 rather than switching the GPU type, which needs the maintainer
one nucleus sample per item: evaluation-sampling noise is inside the item-level bootstrap, and the per-item seed is common to every checkpoint
provider_safety: before every authorization (h1pa_governance.live_position) and again at every launch (h1pa_launch.the_project_cap_holds_now) the provider's billing and account are read NOW: everything billed, plus each closed session the provider has not posted yet, plus the study's unretired storage; a session whose hard cap does not fit the project cap's remainder, or an account holding any pod or volume the study does not own, is refused; no cap is ever raised automatically
termination_protection: one one-use authorization per session, bound to the study identity and the harness, refused at $0 when its hard cap does not fit what the cumulative envelope has left (h1pa_governance.issue)

the all-in bound (GPU + 150 GB container disk + the 1.25 min termination margin) at the launch price inside the session's cap, or no pod (h1_generation_launch.all_in_within_cap); the watchdog's hard deadline follows the accepted price
account funds and provider reconciliation before every create: only the study's volume may exist
at most one billing pod at a time; one network volume

the driver persists every checkpoint, save point and evaluation to the volume as it completes; a lost pod resumes from the last save point in a new subrun, never retraining a trained unit or re-running a scored one
the same-failure gate: a deterministic paid failure is never retried unchanged
teardown gate, the provider's confirmation that the pod is gone, a closeout per session, and the volume retired or kept by an explicit decision at the end
